title: Without __hash__, ModelChoiceIteratorValue raises TypeError 'unhashable type' when used as dict key (ticket #31885 repro)
With __hash__ = hash(self.value), ModelChoiceIteratorValue works as dict key / in dict membership (ticket #31885 fixed)
